stored_value: chart_facts ashtakavarga_bindu_sign.bindus holds BENEFIC-point counts 0..8 (E0 section 3). No malefic-count row exists.
rule: A card's bindus operand is evaluable only when its count term is declared for its text here, or the term itself says benefic (e.g. 'benefic dots'). A text that counts malefic points would need 8 - value, and must be declared here first. Undeclared means quarantine (BINDU_CONVENTION_UNDECLARED). No threshold is ever supplied here.

rekha.basis: BPHS (Santhanam) uses 'rekha' for the benefic points (ENGINE_PLAN v0.2 section 2.1; E0 section 3; F-S2)

benefic_dot.basis: the verse's own words name the points benefic
